title: Global AI Summit LIVE | PM Modi & President Macron Unveil Future of Artificial Intelligence in Delhi
text: Global AI Summit LIVE | PM Modi & President Macron Unveil Future of Artificial Intelligence in DelhiNEW DELHI - India is hosting the global Artificial Intelligence Impact summit, cementing its position as a key player in the worldwide deployment of advanced AI technologies, with Prime Minister Narendra Modi and visiting French President Emmanuel Macron delivering keynote addresses. The high-level summit focuses on critical themes including ethical and inclusive AI, the role of artificial intelligence in governance and public services, fostering innovation for sustainable development, and establishing international frameworks for AI regulation.
